common_solver_settings.dt_note: Retained metadata only; steady Reynolds and energy equations omit physical storage, and bearing motion is not integrated.

per_case_mapping.inflow_temperature: tc0_boundary_temperature_k for each confirmed feed reservoir
per_case_mapping.reference_sommerfeld_number: sommerfeld_number; uses nominal RPM and mu(TC0)
per_case_mapping.temperature_comparison: tc2_measured_mean_c after sensor position is known
per_case_mapping.rho_cp: rho(TC0)*2010; constant volumetric heat capacity within each case

force_balance.target: total fluid-on-bearing force equals minus the specified applied load vector
force_balance.load_frame: Chosen coordinates: applied load along -y (270 degrees), groove along +y (90 degrees); positive theta follows journal rotation. This is a coordinate convention, not a further experimental input.
force_balance.note: Do not treat input eccentricity as measured or infer it from matched S. load_angle_deg alone does not control force direction in the current solver.

acceptance.pressure_and_temperature_coupling: Both normalized changes below 1e-6 with converged status; restored best or iteration cap is a failure.
acceptance.force_balance: Vector residual relative to specified load below 0.002 after a converged thermal solve.
acceptance.fields: Finite temperatures/pressure/torque, positive gap, admissible liquid filling, recorded mass and energy diagnostics.
acceptance.friction_prerequisite: F0/F1 wall shear correction implemented and independently regression-tested; quantitative comparison still requires converged load/thermal solution.
acceptance.external_convection: Each force evaluation must close both h coefficients to relative1e-3 and wall-temperature change0.01K after an inner converged pressure/thermal solve.

specified_boundaries.provenance: User follow-up: 5 mm groove opposite load, same reservoir conditions as bearing ends, p_cav=0, stainless OD85 mm and L40 mm; surrounding still oil at TC0, estimate natural convection.

groove.width_interpretation: Circumferential arc at the nominal bore, treated as a full-length axial groove.
groove.pressure: 101325 Pa absolute, equal to both axial-end reservoirs
groove.temperature: Each case TC0, same as the axial-end reservoir.
groove.thermal_closure: Fed reservoir at TC0; native PINNED groove temperature, no measured hot-oil mixing fraction.

pressure.requested_pressure_reference: interpreted absolute alongside user-specified 1 atm reservoirs
pressure.note: Zero absolute cavity pressure supported for the restricted gas-free FBNS path; reservoir pressure101325Pa absolute. This preserves the requested distinct plateau and reservoir values.

housing.native_cht_geometry_note: Existing r-theta solid solver starts at journal R, a thin-film approximation; axial solid end-face cooling is not represented.
housing.outside_boundary: Natural convection to still FW68D at case TC0

natural_convection.status: implemented in run_steady.py; validating before production
natural_convection.property_temperature: Mean of outer housing surface temperature and TC0
natural_convection.coupling_plan: Update a uniform mean h using converged mean outer surface temperature within each load-balance evaluation; re-solve thermal/pressure coupling until h and surface temperature settle.
natural_convection.limitations: L/D=0.47 is short: long-cylinder lateral-surface estimate only. Confinement, mounting contacts and annular end-face cooling are not resolved; no measured h is implied.

shaft.ambient: case TC0 in still surrounding oil
shaft.surface_temperature: Existing global shaft heat balance solves shaft temperature
shaft.coefficient_updated: At the mean of solved shaft temperature and TC0
shaft.limitations: Unconfined-end estimate; one shaft temperature, no resolved axial conduction or nearby housing obstruction.

material_settings.pressure_reference: absolute; zero cavity retained separately from atmospheric reservoirs
material_settings.oil_thermal_analogue: BITZER BVC32 PVE: published 40C cp/k, treated constant; FW68D viscosity/density remain experiment-supplied
material_settings.shaft_temperature_model: Existing globally isothermal shaft, finite convective heat sink at two end faces; no resolved axial conduction
material_settings.authority: User allowed normal or most similar thermophysical properties and specified both circular shaft ends exposed to TC0.
material_settings.shaft_end_correlation_assumptions: Laminar unconfined rotating disks, high Pr, properties at mean shaft/oil temperature. Rotation-dominated cooling; housing coefficient is separate.

model_assumptions: Zero cavity pressure is interpreted absolute, distinct from1atm reservoirs.
BVC32 PVE cp and k are constant analogues; FW68D nu(T) and suppliedrho(T) unchanged.
Shaft is represented by one equilibrated temperature; two circularendfaces43mm diameter convect toTC0.
Housing r-theta conduction lacks axial/endfacecooling; assesscoolingsensitivity.

material_sensitivity_plan.meaning: Chosen sensitivity scenarios, not measured uncertainty bounds; evaluate if nominal comparison requires them.
